name: PhotonTools
shortDescription: An extension for working with Photon Engine. Create p2p games. Easily create rooms and send messages to the server.
description: Create rooms in a couple of actions; initialize the Photon SDK in a single action. Check the number of players on the server using a function. Sync object positions between client and host with just two behaviors.
